Data.Data:
Operation Commander:

It looks like we miscalculated your course and shot you straight into a xenomorph nest. Sorry. On the bright side, your pod has tunneling equipment so you can get the drop on those NT goons. We also sent your backup/escape ship via remote control. It's in space near your position--coordinates 191, 62.

To recap the briefing: Construction has just begun on NT's base on the other side of this huge asteroid, and some ships are on-site as well. Your target is the NT freighter ship servicing the construction site from space to its south. It contains valuable equipment and their AI, so be prepared for automated defenses. Now go kick some ass, and remember to leave yourself time to get off the asteroid before the nuke goes off!
